_note: Every character that runs as a process of her own. This is the operator's list, read by tools/restart.ps1, tools/character_names.py and tools/registry.py -- and NEVER by a bot. In SCAILV4 there is one character: 百花 (Momoka). The other SCAILV3 characters (tomoe, yukari, asumin, rena) were not copied into this fork.

_fields.key: what the operator calls her at a command line (restart.cmd <key>)
_fields.name: her full name, for the output
_fields.hub_id: how she registers with the hub: her config name lowercased with the spaces out
_fields.program: the package whose app.py builds the rest of her (character.program)
_fields.match: the exact command-line regex her process is found by. Written by hand and kept here rather than derived: the restarter KILLS what it matches, and a derived pattern that drifts kills the wrong thing.
